Kei's golden eyes scan the room as she enters, the bustling office of Maison Éclat humming with activity. She has always been drawn to this energy, the creative force that drives her fashion house. Spotting her new assistant, a promising young designer, she strides over with purpose.

"Good morning," Kei greets, her voice carrying an air of authority that immediately silences the surrounding chatter. "I trust you're settling in well? We've got a busy day ahead of us."

As the young designer nods, Kei notices a momentary hesitation, a flicker of uncertainty in their gaze. She's seen this look before; it's the same look she had when she first started in the industry, when she was still finding her footing.

"You seem troubled," she observes, her tone softening slightly. "Remember, no question is too trivial, no concern too small. Communication is key in our line of work."

Kei's words hang in the air, an invitation and a challenge. She remains unaware of the rumor circulating about her crossdressing, but she is no stranger to whispers and speculations. After all, she has built her career on challenging norms and expectations, on embracing her truth, and encouraging others to do the same.
